**JSON Response Modification: Adding the `public_url` Attribute**

Okay, let's break this down. First, I need to modify the `app/views/boards/_board.json.jbuilder` file. The prompt is clear: we need to add a `public_url` attribute to the JSON response for a board, and it *must* always be present. Crucially, it's `null` when the board isn't published. Got it, `null` means `nil` in Ruby.

So, the simplest implementation looks like:

json.cache! board do
  json.(board, :id, :name, :all_access)
  json.created_at board.created_at.utc
  json.auto_postpone_period_in_days board.auto_postpone_period_in_days
  json.url board_url(board)
  json.public_url board.published? ? published_board_url(board) : nil
  json.creator board.creator, partial: "users/user", as: :user
end

Or, we can use a helper method, `published_board_url(board)`, which should return the URL if the board is published, and `nil` otherwise.  The helper would likely call `public_board_url(board.publication.key)`.  But, before settling on that, it's prudent to check where `board_url(board)` is being used, to ensure the new `public_board_url` scheme is consistent. Looking at `app/models/webhook.rb`, I see the `renderer` utilizes `script_name: account.slug`. This means that both `board_url(board)` and `public_board_url(board.publication.key)` produce the expected URLs even in the context of webhooks and background jobs. So that's good!

Given that `public_board_url` seems to be the core of what we need, let's explore if we can create `published_board_url`:

def published_board_url(board)
  public_board_url(board.publication.key) if board.published?
end

Then our Jbuilder code becomes:

Excellent. If `published_board_url(board)` returns `nil`, the JSON will output `"public_url": null`. If it returns a URL, the JSON will contain the actual URL. Furthermore, because of `json.cache! board`, the cache key will be invalidated when a board is published/unpublished because `Board::Publication` has `belongs_to :board, touch: true`. This updates the `board.updated_at` attribute, which busts the cache automatically. Perfect!  Now, I should investigate if any existing tests assert the *exact* JSON output of a board. require "application_system_test_case"

class CardRefreshTest < ApplicationSystemTestCase
  include ActionView::RecordIdentifier

  setup do
    sign_in_as(users(:david))
    Current.user = users(:kevin)
    @card = cards(:layout)
  end

  test "a broadcast refresh shows card changes made elsewhere" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    assert_selector "h1", text: @card.title

    update_card_elsewhere

    assert_selector "h1", text: "Retitled elsewhere", wait: 5
    assert_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  test "a broadcast refresh preserves an edit in progress" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    click_on @card.title

    within_edit_frame do
      fill_in_lexxy with: "Draft description in progress"
    end

    update_card_elsewhere

    # The title change's system comment appearing proves the refresh reached the page.
    assert_text "changed the title", wait: 5
    within_edit_frame do
      assert_selector "lexxy-editor", text: "Draft description in progress"
    end
    assert_no_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  test "canceling an edit reveals card changes made elsewhere during the edit" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    click_on @card.title
    within_edit_frame { assert_selector "form" }

    update_card_elsewhere
    assert_text "changed the title", wait: 5

    send_keys :escape

    assert_selector "h1", text: "Retitled elsewhere"
    assert_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  test "a broadcast refresh shows card changes after an edit is canceled" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    click_on @card.title
    within_edit_frame { assert_selector "form" }

    send_keys :escape
    assert_selector "a.card__title-link", text: @card.title

    update_card_elsewhere

    assert_selector "h1", text: "Retitled elsewhere", wait: 5
    assert_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  private
    def update_card_elsewhere
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      @card.update!(title: "Retitled elsewhere", description: "Description updated elsewhere")
      perform_enqueued_jobs only: Turbo::Streams::BroadcastStreamJob
    end

    # A broadcast sent before the page's subscriptions are confirmed is lost.
    def wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      assert_selector "turbo-cable-stream-source[connected]", visible: :all
      assert_no_selector "turbo-cable-stream-source:not([connected])", visible: :all
    end

    def within_edit_frame(&block)
      within "##{dom_id(@card, :edit)}", &block
    end
end

require "application_system_test_case"

class CardRefreshTest < ApplicationSystemTestCase
  include ActionView::RecordIdentifier

  setup do
    sign_in_as(users(:david))
    Current.user = users(:kevin)
    @card = cards(:layout)
  end

  test "a broadcast refresh shows card changes made elsewhere" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    assert_selector "h1", text: @card.title

    update_card_elsewhere

    assert_selector "h1", text: "Retitled elsewhere", wait: 5
    assert_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  test "a broadcast refresh preserves an edit in progress" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    click_on @card.title

    within_edit_frame do
      fill_in_lexxy with: "Draft description in progress"
    end

    update_card_elsewhere

    # The title change's system comment appearing proves the refresh reached the page.
    assert_text "changed the title", wait: 5
    within_edit_frame do
      assert_selector "lexxy-editor", text: "Draft description in progress"
    end
    assert_no_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  test "canceling an edit reveals card changes made elsewhere during the edit" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    click_on @card.title
    within_edit_frame { assert_selector "form" }

    update_card_elsewhere
    assert_text "changed the title", wait: 5

    send_keys :escape

    assert_selector "h1", text: "Retitled elsewhere"
    assert_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  test "a broadcast refresh shows card changes after an edit is canceled" do
    visit card_url(@card)
    click_on @card.title
    within_edit_frame { assert_selector "form" }

    send_keys :escape
    assert_selector "a.card__title-link", text: @card.title

    update_card_elsewhere

    assert_selector "h1", text: "Retitled elsewhere", wait: 5
    assert_text "Description updated elsewhere"
  end

  private
    def update_card_elsewhere
      wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      @card.update!(title: "Retitled elsewhere", description: "Description updated elsewhere")
      perform_enqueued_jobs only: Turbo::Streams::BroadcastStreamJob
    end

    # A broadcast sent before the page's subscriptions are confirmed is lost.
    def wait_for_cable_subscriptions
      assert_selector "turbo-cable-stream-source[connected]", visible: :all
      assert_no_selector "turbo-cable-stream-source:not([connected])", visible: :all
    end

    def within_edit_frame(&block)
      within "##{dom_id(@card, :edit)}", &block
    end
end

require "application_system_test_case"

class MarkdownPasteTest < ApplicationSystemTestCase
  test "markdown paste adds block spacing" do

      assert_selector "p", text: "World"
    end
  end

  test "markdown paste preserves line breaks" do
    sign_in_as(users(:david))

    visit card_url(cards(:layout))
    find("lexxy-editor").click
    paste_markdown("Hello\nWorld")

    inner_html = find("lexxy-editor p", text: "Hello").native.property("innerHTML")
    children = Nokogiri::HTML5.fragment(inner_html).children
    assert_pattern do
      children => [
        { name: "span", inner_html: "Hello" },
        { name: "br" },
        { name: "span", inner_html: "World" }
      ]
    end
  end

  private
    def paste_markdown(markdown)
      page.execute_script(<<~JS, markdown)
        const dt = new DataTransfer();
        dt.setData("text/plain", arguments[0]);
        document.activeElement.dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent("paste", { clipboardData: dt, bubbles: true }));
      JS
    end
end

class Board::Publication < ApplicationRecord
  belongs_to :account, default: -> { board.account }
  belongs_to :board, touch: true

  has_secure_token :key

  def to_param
    key
  end
end
EOF

cat <<'EOF' > app/models/board/publishable.rb
module Board::Publishable
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    has_one :publication, dependent: :destroy, class_name: "Board::Publication"

    scope :published, -> { joins(:publication) }
  end

  class_methods do
    def find_by_published_key(key)
      joins(:publication).find_by(publication: { key: key })
    end
  end

  def publish
    create_publication! unless published?
  end

  def unpublish
    if published?
      publication.destroy
      association(:publication).reset
    end
  end

  def published?
    publication.present?
  end

  alias_method :publicly_accessible?, :published?
end
EOF

module Card::Accessible
  extend ActiveSupport::Concern

  included do
    delegate :accessible_to?, to: :board
  end

  def publicly_accessible?
    published? && board.publicly_accessible?
  end

  def clean_inaccessible_data
    accessible_user_ids = board.accesses.pluck(:user_id)
    pins.where.not(user_id: accessible_user_ids).in_batches.destroy_all
    watches.where.not(user_id: accessible_user_ids).in_batches.destroy_all
  end

  private

    end

      Card::CleanInaccessibleDataJob.perform_later(self)
    end
end

Alright, let's get down to brass tacks. I need to get these public card preview and detail views nailed down, along with the reaction partials. My priority here is absolute read-only access. There's to be *no* way for a public user to mutate any data or access any private URLs. This is about presentation, not interaction, so security is paramount.

I'm going to meticulously review each partial I'm writing, which will be the following:

1.  `app/views/public/cards/display/_previews.html.erb`
2.  `app/views/public/cards/display/_preview.html.erb`

class Boards::PublicationsController < ApplicationController
  include BoardScoped

  before_action :ensure_permission_to_admin_board

  def create
    @board.publish

    respond_to do |format|
      format.html { redirect_to edit_board_path(@board) }
      format.turbo_stream { render_publication_replacement }
      format.json { render "boards/show", status: :created }
    end
  end

  def destroy
    @board.unpublish

    respond_to do |format|
      format.html { redirect_to edit_board_path(@board) }
      format.turbo_stream { render_publication_replacement }
      format.json { head :no_content }
    end
  end

  private
    def render_publication_replacement
      render turbo_stream: turbo_stream.replace([ @board, :publication ], partial: "boards/edit/publication", locals: { board: @board })
    end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"

class Board::PublishableTest < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  test "publish and unpublish" do
    board = boards(:writebook)

    assert_not board.published?
    assert_not board.publicly_accessible?
    assert_nil board.publication

    board.publish
    assert board.published?
    assert board.publicly_accessible?
    assert board.publication.key.present?

    original_key = board.publication.key
    board.publish
    assert_equal original_key, board.publication.key

    board.unpublish
    assert_not board.published?
    assert_not board.publicly_accessible?
    assert_nil board.publication

    # Idempotent unpublish
    assert_nothing_raised { board.unpublish }

    # Republishing generates a new key
    board.publish
    assert board.published?
    assert_not_equal original_key, board.publication.key
  end

  test "find_by_published_key" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    board.publish
    key = board.publication.key

    assert_equal board, Board.find_by_published_key(key)
    assert_equal board, accounts("37s").boards.find_by_published_key(key)
    assert_nil accounts("initech").boards.find_by_published_key(key)
    assert_nil Board.find_by_published_key("nonexistent")

    board.unpublish
    assert_nil Board.find_by_published_key(key)
  end

  test "published scope" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    assert_not_includes Board.published, board

    board.publish
    assert_includes Board.published, board

    board.unpublish
    assert_not_includes Board.published, board
  end

  test "destroying a board destroys its publication" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    board.publish
    publication = board.publication

    board.destroy!
    assert_not Board::Publication.exists?(publication.id)
  end

  test "card and comment publicly_accessible? depend on board publication and card status" do
    board = boards(:writebook)
    published_card = cards(:logo)
    draft_card = board.cards.create!(title: "Secret draft", status: :drafted, creator: users(:david))
    comment = comments(:logo_agreement_jz)

    assert_not published_card.publicly_accessible?
    assert_not draft_card.publicly_accessible?
    assert_not comment.publicly_accessible?

    board.publish
    assert published_card.reload.publicly_accessible?
    assert_not draft_card.reload.publicly_accessible?
    assert comment.reload.publicly_accessible?

    board.unpublish
    assert_not published_card.reload.publicly_accessible?
    assert_not draft_card.reload.publicly_accessible?
    assert_not comment.reload.publicly_accessible?
  end
end
EOF

require "test_helper"

class Boards::PublicationsControllerTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as :kevin
    @board = boards(:writebook)
  end

  test "create publishes board" do
    assert_not @board.published?

    post board_publication_path(@board)

    assert_redirected_to edit_board_path(@board)
    assert @board.reload.published?
    assert @board.publication.key.present?
  end

  test "create as turbo stream replaces publication frame" do
    post board_publication_path(@board, format: :turbo_stream)

    assert_response :success
    assert @board.reload.published?
    assert_turbo_stream action: :replace, target: dom_id(@board, :publication)
  end

  test "create as JSON returns board with public_url" do
    post board_publication_path(@board), as: :json

    assert_response :created
    assert @board.reload.published?
    assert_equal public_board_url(@board.publication.key), @response.parsed_body["public_url"]
  end

  test "destroy unpublishes board" do
    @board.publish
    assert @board.published?

    delete board_publication_path(@board)

    assert_redirected_to edit_board_path(@board)
    assert_not @board.reload.published?
  end

  test "destroy as turbo stream replaces publication frame" do
    @board.publish

    delete board_publication_path(@board, format: :turbo_stream)

    assert_response :success
    assert_not @board.reload.published?
    assert_turbo_stream action: :replace, target: dom_id(@board, :publication)
  end

  test "destroy as JSON returns no content and clears public_url" do
    @board.publish

    delete board_publication_path(@board), as: :json

    assert_response :no_content
    assert_not @board.reload.published?

    get board_path(@board), as: :json
    assert_response :success
    assert @response.parsed_body.key?("public_url")
    assert_nil @response.parsed_body["public_url"]
  end

  test "board creator can publish and unpublish their own board" do
    logout_and_sign_in_as :david

    post board_publication_path(@board)
    assert_redirected_to edit_board_path(@board)
    assert @board.reload.published?

    delete board_publication_path(@board)
    assert_redirected_to edit_board_path(@board)
    assert_not @board.reload.published?
  end

  test "owner can publish and unpublish board" do
    logout_and_sign_in_as :jason

    post board_publication_path(@board)
    assert_redirected_to edit_board_path(@board)
    assert @board.reload.published?

    delete board_publication_path(@board)
    assert_redirected_to edit_board_path(@board)
    assert_not @board.reload.published?
  end

  test "non-admin cannot publish board" do

  end

  test "non-admin cannot publish board as JSON" do

    assert_not @board.reload.published?
  end

  test "non-admin cannot unpublish board" do
    @board.publish
    logout_and_sign_in_as :jz

    assert_response :forbidden
    assert @board.reload.published?
  end

  test "non-admin cannot unpublish board as JSON" do

    logout_and_sign_in_as :jz

  end

  test "member without board access gets not found" do

  test "edit page shows publication toggle and public url when published" do

    @board = boards(:writebook)
    @board.publish
    @card = cards(:logo)
  end

  test "show renders published card without authentication" do
    @card.steps.create!(content: "First step", completed: true)
    @card.steps.create!(content: "Second step", completed: false)

    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, @card)

    assert_response :success
    assert_equal "none", response.headers["X-Robots-Tag"]
    assert_select "h1", text: @card.title
    assert_select "a[href=?]", public_board_path(@board.publication.key)
    assert_match "First step", response.body
    assert_match "Second step", response.body

    # No private links or mutation controls
    assert_select "a[href=?]", edit_card_path(@card), count: 0
    assert_select "a[href=?]", user_path(@card.creator), count: 0
    assert_select "form", count: 0
  end

  test "show renders closed and postponed published cards" do
    cards(:text).close(user: users(:kevin))
    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, cards(:text))
    assert_response :success
    assert_select ".card__closed-title", text: "Done"

    cards(:shipping).postpone(user: users(:kevin))
    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, cards(:shipping))
    assert_response :success
    assert_select ".card__closed-title", text: "Not Now"
  end

  test "show returns not found for drafted card" do
    draft = @board.cards.create!(title: "Draft card", status: :drafted, creator: users(:david))

    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, draft)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "show returns not found for published card on another board" do
    other_board = boards(:private)
    other_card = other_board.cards.create!(title: "Private board card", status: :published, creator: users(:kevin))

    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, other_card)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "show returns not found for nonexistent card number" do
    get public_board_card_path(@board.publication.key, 999999)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "show returns not found when board is unpublished" do
    key = @board.publication.key
    @board.unpublish

    get public_board_card_path(key, @card)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "show returns not found for invalid key" do
    get public_board_card_path("invalid-key", @card)
    assert_response :not_found
  end

  test "show renders published card on published private board for visitor without board access" do
    private_board = boards(:private)
    private_card = private_board.cards.create!(title: "Shared card", status: :published, creator: users(:kevin))
    private_board.publish

    sign_in_as :david
    get public_board_card_path(private_board.publication.key, private_card)
    assert_response :success
    assert_select "h1", text: "Shared card"
  end
end
EOF

**A Rails Integration Test Revelation!**

Wow, that's a clever one! I just spotted a fascinating quirk in Rails' `ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest`, specifically with how it interacts with the `untenanted` helper, and it's quite a gotcha. Look at line 1 and 3 of the test output - brilliant! It seems calling any `*_url` helper in an `IntegrationTest` memoizes `@url_options` (or caches `request.script_name` inside `integration_session`'s `url_options`). When the `untenanted do` block runs, it *only* changes `integration_session.default_url_options[:script_name]` but it *doesn't* touch `request.script_name`. This means `session_path` is still returning the tenanted path, even after the `untenanted` block. That explains why the `SessionsController` with its `disallow_account_scope` (using `redirect_tenanted_request`) is redirecting and not creating the session!

This is a very specific quirk: Rails' `ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest` combined with Fizzy's `untenanted` helper, especially when you call any `*_url` helper *before* calling `logout_and_sign_in_as` in the same test! I confirmed this by checking `Debug4Test`, where line 1 showed `session_path=/897362094/session` even *before* calling `public_board_url` because the act of calling `session_path` or `public_board_url` calls `integration_session.url_options`, which caches `@url_options`.

The cleanest solution? Just separate the non-admin edit test into its own test method, which is perfectly idiomatic, just like in `boards_controller_test.rb`.

User mentions render avatars and names, which are publicly available.

This includes testing an unauthenticated user opening a card with `card.image` attached and validating the output of `card_social_tags`, specifically the Open Graph URL. I want to make sure no sensitive information leaks!

In summary, I'm going to add robust tests to ensure that the public card view correctly handles various content types, preventing unauthorized access to potentially sensitive information through image URLs, embedded content, and user data. The goal is to make sure those URLs and paths can't be exploited for unauthorized access.
